dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible posterior trunk as it approaches the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel reflectance across the primary dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, thin, dark linear mark or shallow ridge following the central longitudinal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A subtle longitudinal topological depression coincident with the visible central axial mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a single longitudinal linear scar or ridge centered on the posterior dorsal plane.
